bifrost: No SDK module. Ad hoc equivalents: springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs, springboard/src/media/convert.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs, springboard/src/shell/books/engine/inflate.rs, springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs
summary: Accelerate's vector, signal, linear algebra, sparse solver, compression and ML APIs have no BifrOSt SDK counterpart. The system and apps contain private equivalents (quarter-turn rotation, YUV to RGBA conversion, DEFLATE decoding, a radix-2 FFT convolver, brightness and contrast lookup tables), but no app can call them through the SDK.

features.feature: vDSP vector arithmetic and stride operations
features.apple: vDSP (vector-vector and vector-scalar operations, strided access, interpolation, decimation)
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No public vector arithmetic API. The only resampler is private to the AAC decoder.

features.apple: vDSP Fourier transforms, Discrete Cosine transforms, fast Fourier transforms
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-27, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The FFT is app-local to the DAW convolver. No SDK transform API and no DCT.

features.apple: vImage convolution kernels, dilation and erosion (Convolution, Morphology collections)
features.note: Blur exists for materials. No general kernel convolution, dilation or erosion.

features.apple: vImage geometric transforms (rotate, reflect, shear, scale) and resampling
features.note: Quarter-turn rotation and a resample for emoji only. No shear, arbitrary-angle transform, or Lanczos resampling API.

features.apple: vImage alpha blending and blend modes
features.note: Source-over alpha blend only. No blend-mode set and no SDK-level image compositing.

features.apple: vImage convert-any-to-any (CMYK, planar and interleaved formats, YUV and RGB)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-accelerate, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. NV12 and RGBA to premultiplied RGBA for the video thread. No CMYK, no grayscale conversion, and no public conversion API.

features.apple: vImage gamma, tone curves, histogram calculation, specification and equalization
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs:287 (per-channel lookup table: contrast then brightness)
features.note: A brightness and contrast lookup table inside the Photos app. No histogram, equalization or tone-curve API.

features.apple: Compression (buffer, stream and filter APIs), Directories and Data Archives
features.note: DEFLATE and zlib decoding exist inside the Books engine. There is no compressor and no SDK compression API. The PNG writer emits uncompressed blocks.

features.apple: BLAS, LAPACK, Sparse Solvers, Solving systems of linear equations
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No matrix solver or BLAS-style routines. The constraint solver serves layout only.

features.apple: Working with Vectors, Matrices and Quaternions; simd; vForce
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No public small-vector or quaternion types. vForce-style vector transcendental functions are missing.

Wave 5 (theme-12, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No neural network inference or training API for apps. Searches for neural network and tensor code found nothing.

features.apple: Biquadratic IIR filters, audio spectrogram sample (vDSP plus vImage)
features.bifrost: springboard/audiod (playback service), springboard/src/media/audioplayer.rs, biquad filter chain in springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/inst/zones/mod.rs
features.note: Audio playback runs in the system daemon. Biquad filtering exists only inside the DAW instrument. No DSP filter API for apps.

features.apple: Core Video interoperability with vImage pixel buffers
features.note: Video frames are converted in the media layer. Apps get no pixel buffer API.

features.apple: Quadrature (definite integration over finite or infinite intervals)
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-36, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No numerical integration routines.

gaps: No SDK module for vDSP, vImage, BNNS, compression, BLAS/LAPACK, sparse solvers or simd.
No app-facing FFT or DCT API. The only FFT is private to the DAW convolver (springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs).
No compressor. DEFLATE is decode-only and lives in the Books engine, and the PNG writer stores uncompressed blocks.
No general image convolution, morphology, histogram, or arbitrary-angle geometric transform API.
No public pixel-format conversion for CMYK or planar formats. Only NV12 and RGBA to RGBA exists, in the media layer.
No neural network inference or training API for apps.
No small-vector, matrix or quaternion types exposed to the SDK.
